i1.title: Narciso Rodriguez All Of Me Eau de Parfum 50ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Every facet of femininity, in one bottle.

Narciso Rodriguez All Of Me Eau de Parfum 50ml is a floral musky fragrance for women, launched in 2023 and created by perfumers Dora Baghriche and Daphné Bugey. Fresh magnolia opens onto a radiant heart of rose centifolia and geranium bourbon, wrapped in the signature Narciso musk and a soft, creamy sandalwood base.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Magnolia
  • Heart: Rose Centifolia, Geranium Bourbon
  • Base: Musk, Sandalwood

Key details

  • Brand: Narciso Rodriguez
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 50ml
  • Scent profile: Floral · Musky
  • Wear: Women

Why you'll love it

  • A fresh magnolia opening
  • A radiant rose and geranium heart
  • The signature Narciso Rodriguez musk
  • A 50ml Eau de Parfum

FAQ

What does All Of Me smell like?

Magnolia first, then rose centifolia and geranium bourbon, finishing with musk and sandalwood.

Is it for women?

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.
